decisions.statement: A changed file is asked for the tests beside it by name rather than by listing.
A test the change answers no body for is left out of the names.
A name is answered once however many changed files name it.
A manifest is read for the name its package is reached under and nothing else.
That name is answered against the folder the link would sit in.
Nothing here runs a test, reads a run or writes a body.

definition: what a change names for the test run that change calls for
